description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Noel)] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Noel)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Ice abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Noel)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Noel)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts speed x9999999 for Ice abilities, causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (25s)] after using Ice abilities if 0-3 FF13 allies are alive, grants [Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3] to all allies after using Ice abilities if 4+ FF13 allies are alive

description.name: Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3
description.text: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark and Poison abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
